requestArguments.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: original illustrated lobby backdrop for a new playable Chinese Daoist chibi survivors game, landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080 or highest native landscape detail available.
Input image 1 and input image 2 are visual STYLE references only: adopt their premium hand-painted jade greens, ivory silk-paper warmth, fine warm gold, rounded auspicious cloud motifs and charming big-head short-body character drawing. Do not reproduce their interface text, layout, or characters exactly.
Create a beautiful daylight adventure key illustration: on the left half a joyful ORIGINAL little Daoist apprentice with a pure golden headband, short brown hair, huge expressive brown eyes, jade green short vest over ivory robes, rounded little shoes, a gold-and-jade gourd tied to the belt, holding a glowing paper talisman; a tiny white fox spirit beside him. Keep full figures within the left 52%, about 65% canvas height, three-quarter view. Their faces should have the delicate lively rendering of the reference.
Behind them: luminous layered jade mountains, pale waterfalls and cloud sea, small distant rounded Daoist tiled roofs, a blossoming peach branch at upper left, just one subtle red hanging tassel or lantern attached to a roof, a few softly drifting peach petals. Late-morning clear light. Foreground smooth warm gray stone with a restrained engraved taiji circle. Do not fill the ground with red/gold ornaments.
The RIGHT 40% is calm soft pale teal mist and distant mountains, sparse detail, suitable behind a readable UI panel. Keep lower 12% uncluttered for navigation overlay. Clear focal hierarchy, tasteful brush texture and exquisite soft shading, polished hand-drawn Chinese fantasy game art. Rounded full forms, no plastic gloss, no pixel art, no realism, no muddy grunge, no dense speckle noise.
CRITICAL: This is an illustration layer only. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO UI frames, NO buttons, NO logo, NO watermark. Avoid cropping heads, limbs or the gourd. Preserve the specified Daoist chibi aesthetic.
